Section 2.  Reduction.  Provided Tenant has not been more than ten (10) business days late in the payment of Base Rent or Additional Rent on more than one occasion during the preceding twenty-four (24) months, the Security Deposit shall automatically be reduced by fifty percent (50%) on the second anniversary of the Commencement Date, and the remaining balance shall be returned to Tenant in full on the fourth anniversary of the Commencement Date, in each case without any requirement that Tenant request such reduction.

Section 2.  Reduction.  Provided that no Event of Default has occurred, Tenant has not paid Base Rent or Additional Rent late more than once during the preceding twenty-four (24) months, and Tenant has delivered current financial statements reasonably demonstrating that its net worth and liquidity have not materially declined from the Commencement Date, the Security Deposit shall be reduced to two (2) months’ then-current Base Rent on the fourth anniversary of the Commencement Date. In no event shall the Security Deposit be reduced below one (1) month’s then-current Base Rent during the Term.
